_comment: Per-(problem, difficulty) experiment sizing for the ITCAS sweep. budget/batch_size/n_init scale with the problem (dimension, #objectives) and the difficulty (joint-feasible fraction), so they live here instead of in scripts/jobs.json (which only selects the sweep matrix: method x problem x difficulty x seeds). Resolution order for each field: problems[<problem>][<difficulty>] -> problems[<problem>].defaults -> top-level defaults. The <difficulty> key is the threshold_pct string (e.g. "0.05"); for uncalibrated/default-threshold runs the key is "defaults". eps_archive is the ε-Archive Size distance threshold in normalised objective space (0.05 = 5% of the normalised range). Owned jointly: the Slurm Operator wires it into the launcher; the Scientific Coder tunes the numbers.

ackley_rosenbrock_6d._comment: Benchmark 17 - Ackley vs. Rosenbrock (D=6, 2 obj). Central multi-modal funnel vs. asymmetric banana valley.

all_valley_8d._comment: Benchmark 24 - All-Valley Trade-off (D=8, 4 obj). Four competing narrow-valley ridge floors.

alpine_12d._comment: Benchmark 16 - 3-obj shifted Alpine N.1 (D=12, 3 obj). Non-differentiable kinks.

dixon_price_10d._comment: Benchmark 14 - Dixon-Price vs Sphere (D=10, 2 obj). Ill-conditioned narrow valley.

dixon_rosenbrock_sphere_12d._comment: Benchmark 22 - Dixon-Price vs. Rosenbrock vs. Sphere (D=12, 3 obj). Two narrow valleys against a smooth sphere; hyper-precise gradient tracking required.

dtlz1_12d._comment: Benchmark 8 - contextual DTLZ1 (D=12, 4 obj). Rastrigin-based multi-modal context.

dtlz3_8d._comment: Benchmark 11 - contextual DTLZ3 (D=8, 4 obj). Rastrigin-based multi-modal context.

dtlz4_12d._comment: Benchmark 13 - contextual DTLZ4 (D=12, 3 obj). Biased density, alpha=100.

dtlz7_6d._comment: Benchmark 6 - contextual DTLZ7 (D=6, 3 obj). Disconnected Pareto front.

ellipsoid_20d._comment: Benchmark 7 - ill-conditioned ellipsoid (D=20, 2 obj). ARD/relevance diagnostic.

ellipsoid_rastrigin_20d._comment: Benchmark 21 - Ellipsoid vs. Rastrigin (D=20, 2 obj). ARD stress test: ill-conditioned scaling vs. equal multi-modal variance across all dims.

griewank_16d._comment: Benchmark 15 - 4-obj shifted Griewank (D=16, 4 obj). Macro-convex micro-rugged.

griewank_vlmop2_16d._comment: Benchmark 26 - Griewank vs. VLMOP2 (D=16, 3 obj). Jagged gradient everywhere vs. exponentially flat landscape; tests mixed gradient-information regimes.

heterogeneous_quadrants_6d._comment: Benchmark 20 - Heterogeneous Quadrants (D=6, 4 obj). Sphere, Ackley, Rastrigin, and Griewank shifted into four conflicting quadrants.

levy_16d._comment: Benchmark 10 - 3-obj shifted Levy (D=16, 3 obj). Rugged multimodal high-D.

multimodal_trap_20d._comment: Benchmark 3 - rugged high-D stress test (D=20, 3 obj). Higher budget for dimension.

rastrigin_griewank_sphere_20d._comment: Benchmark 18 - Rastrigin vs. Griewank vs. Sphere (D=20, 3 obj). Three different macroscopic structures: massive independent local optima, micro-rugged cosine interference, and a smooth conflicting anchor.

rosenbrock_sphere_6d._comment: Benchmark 2 - contextual Rosenbrock vs sphere (D=6, 2 obj).

schwefel_styblinski_sphere_20d._comment: Benchmark 25 - Schwefel vs. Styblinski-Tang vs. Sphere (D=20, 3 obj). Boundary-hidden global optimum (Schwefel) vs. massive internal basins; Schwefel inputs scaled ×100 to map [-500,500] into [-5,5].

spacecraft_formation_flying_a1._comment: Real Basilisk/Slurm simulation (D=16, 3 constraints). n_init draws from pre-filtered historical pool. Difficulty keys 1–4 select (rmse_m, fuel_g, thrust_n) constraint thresholds; pass --threshold_pct 1|2|3|4.

sphere2_6d._comment: Benchmark 1 - 2-obj shifted sphere (D=6, 2 obj). Convex baseline.

styblinski_tang_6d._comment: Benchmark 5 - multi-modal Styblinski-Tang (D=6, 2 obj). Multi-modal trap variant of sphere2_6d.

styblinski_tang_levy_10d._comment: Benchmark 19 - Styblinski-Tang vs. Levy (D=10, 2 obj). Two different deceptive local-minimum styles: nested polynomial-trigonometric trap vs. massive disjoint polynomial basins.

vlmop2_6d._comment: Benchmark 12 - VLMOP2 (D=6, 2 obj). Vanishing gradient / flat landscape.

zakharov_ackley_10d._comment: Benchmark 23 - Zakharov vs. Ackley (D=10, 2 obj). Steep asymmetric plate with correlated gradients vs. flat outer/deep-center multi-modal funnel.

zdt3_6d._comment: Benchmark 9 - contextual ZDT3 (D=6, 2 obj). Disconnected Pareto front.
